reason: Strassen ranks first because the user approved it and the supplied 256-square helper has primitive checks, but no complete wrapper has been measured. The first four proposals overlap on the same three-buffer Strassen design, so treat them as competing descriptions of one experiment, not independent gains. Panel packing is distinct; prior panel layouts did not promote, so its benefit is uncertain. Transpose fusion and the ZA tile or schedule changes have no supporting performance evidence; a prior FMOPA order change also failed promotion. The paired-load proposal has unresolved instruction legality and should be checked before implementation. Tail alignment and the C fallback do not target the timed n=512 path.
